text:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up 15m sync? we've got overlap across 3 PRs touching code snippets and a glossary hole for 'model family' vs 'variant'. @Sam @Priya :wave:
Sam Ortiz: Yep 15 works. agenda?
Priya Nair: Items: 1) snippet param casing inconsistency (curl vs SDK), 2) migration note for customers consuming raw REST, 3) microcopy mismatch in error UX. PR that sparked this: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2405 (mixed edits).
Jon Park: Saw samples using both `modelId` and `model_id`. My rego: JS/TS snippets -> camelCase; Python snippets -> snake_case for kwargs to match idiomatic users; curl/REST -> snake_case. Example:
```js
// prefer (JS)
const out = await client.generate({ modelId: 'redwood-alpha' });
```
```py
# prefer (Python)
resp = client.generate(model_id='redwood-alpha')
```
Leah Gomez: Voice note: our guides are friendly and slightly informal; API ref should be terse and formal. Add: avoid exclamation marks in reference and don't use contractions in reference. I'll add a one-paragraph rule and 3 examples.
docs-bot: created checklist: [split PRs, umbrella issue, CI lint, tone samples]; label applied: docs-style-review.
Maya Patel: Proposed decisions: A) Standard casing per Jon's rego. B) Add migration section in REST reference explicitly mapping param names. C) Small err msg wording rule: prefer active voice, specify what to do next. thumbs?
Sam Ortiz: +1. Also recommend breaking big PRs into follow-ups to reduce conflicts.
Priya Nair: I'll split PR 2405 into: PR A (glossary + microcopy fixes) and PR B (snippet edits + migration doc). Will include a migration note that shows curl->SDK mappings and an automated sed snippet users can run. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Ava Li: For migration note, suggest adding a tiny script in the docs repo: `tools/snippet-migrate.sh` that core devs can run during review to validate casing swaps. I'll sketch it and open a PR.
Jon Park: I'll add a lightweight CI check that scans docs code blocks for common mismatches. Regex-based and opt-out via comment. Will open issue + PR.
Leah Gomez: I'll post 3 before/after microcopy examples in #docs for quick reactions: tutorial, reference, error messages.
Maya Patel: Action recap: Priya splits PRs and adds migration note; Ava drafts migration helper; Jon builds CI lint; Leah supplies tone examples; Sam coordinates reviewers for the split PRs. I'll create umbrella issue and assign owners. Thanks all :sparkles:
Sam Ortiz: great. if we hit blockers we'll huddle Friday.
